# Merged-manifest permission allowlist for Bloom (plan.md §5.7, §11).
#
# CI extracts every permission from the built debug APK and diffs it against this
# file. A new permission must be added here deliberately, with a reason written
# next to it — it can never appear through a dependency bump unnoticed.
#
# There is deliberately no android.permission.INTERNET. Its absence is the privacy
# guarantee that stops any library moving habit data off the device.

android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
